test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ramya lent a certain sum of money at 4% simple interest to Seema and in 8 years the interest amounted to Rs. 3,400 less than the sum lent. Find the sum lent by Ramya to Seema.
solution:
Given:

Rate (R) = 4%

Time (T) = 8 years

Formula used:

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100 

Where, S.I. → Simple Interest

P → Principal

R → Rate 

T → Time 

Calculations:

Let the amount lent be Rs. P.

According to the question,

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (P × 8 × 4)/100

⇒ S.I. = 32P/100

So, (P – 32P/100) = 3400

⇒ P = 5000

∴ The required sum is Rs. 5000.
